name: Beginner 3×/week
description: Full body three times a week — the classic starting point.

name: Intermediate 4×/week
description: Upper / Lower split four days a week for more volume.

name: Maintenance — 2×/week
description: The minimum effective dose. Two full-body sessions per week is all the evidence says you need to preserve muscle and fitness during busy stretches.

name: 5×5 Strength — 3×/week
description: Modelled on proven 5×5 programs (Stronglifts, Starting Strength). Three full-body sessions per week at heavy load — the most evidence-backed approach for building raw strength.

name: Classic Body Part Split — 5×/week
description: One major muscle group per day — the classic bodybuilder split that dominated the golden era. High per-session volume for each body part with full-week recovery.

name: Push / Pull / Legs — 6×/week
description: The gold-standard intermediate hypertrophy program. Each movement pattern trained twice per week with a full day of recovery between same-pattern sessions — maximises volume and frequency.
